item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json\\np='model.json'\\nwith open(p) as f: m=json.load(f)\\nfor rule in m['rules']:\\n    if rule['id'] in {'boolean_attempt_rejected_probe','upper_in_range_attempt_probe'}:\\n        edge={'op':'get','args':[{'op':'get','args':[{'var':'policy'},{'value':'edges'},{'value':{}}]},{'value':'s>t'},{'value':{}}]}\\n        role={'op':'get','args':[edge,{'value':'role'},{'value':None}]}\\n        rule['when']['args'].append({'op':'eq','args':[role,{'value':None}]})\\nwith open(p,'w') as f: json.dump(m,f,indent=2)\\nprint('restricted retry probes to unprotected edge')\"]}"}
